items.text: – Deloken kembang apik sing kok buwang ing banyu, utek taik.
items.q: Someone scolds a friend for a blunder. Is the meaning clear?
before: Eskandar madhep aku, sirah lan dhadhané dicedhakaké marang aku. Mripaté digawe amba, lan karo swara kasar, tanpa ilang nada Alain Delon-é, kandha:

items.text: – Kok, sèlèhna ing friser waé. Yèn mbok sèlèh ing friser, ora bakal apa-apa, senajan nganti setaun.
items.q: Maman mispronounces foreign words on purpose, all through the book. Would an elderly Javanese speaker say freezer as 'friser'? If not, how?
before: – Mm-hm, aku ngerti. Aku mung ngomong, yèn manut aku. Jigaram, sing tak wènèhaké mau wis entèk mbok pangan kabèh?
– Ya, wis tak pangan, Nini-jan. Ora sah kuwatir. Mung kèri sithik lavashak gawéané Mahboub.

items.text: karo cara ngomongmu sing kaya kontol kuwi, jenengmu kudune Alain Kontolon.
items.q: 'Alain Kontolon' is meant as a rude pun on the actor Alain Delon. Would Javanese readers get it? If not, what word could carry it?

items.text: Udan ora tiba munggah saka lemah menyang langit.
items.q: Her son says he would die for her; Maman objects. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?
Amir tells the girl he loves why he holds back. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Maksudku, yèn kowe mung lungguh ing kéné waca puisi terus, ora ana roti sing bakal dadi anget kanggo kowe.
items.q: A friend criticises Amir for reading poetry all day. A Persian expression kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Bibi, muga Gusti ngapura dosané, biyèn ngomong ing wektu kaya ngéné: yèn tak omong, ilatku kobong; yèn ora tak omong, sungsumé balungku kobong.
items.q: Maman hesitates before criticising her husband. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Kandhané, "Taun sing apik ketara wiwit mangsa semi-é."
items.q: The family's New Year visits were cancelled; a brother jokes about it. An old Persian proverb kept word for word: can you guess its meaning?

items.text: Aku saka sisih iki, mbukak lawe tembung, lan kowe saka sisih kana, ngumpulaké.
items.q: The writer unravels a thread of words; you gather them. Does this read naturally?
before: …wektu ing buku iki wis kliwat. Wektu lan gambar-gambar sing bakal ilang ing gumrengé jagad sing ribut yen ora dicathet ing kene. Dicathet supaya dadi kreteg antarane jagadku lan jagadmu. Kreteg saka jagadku, ing wektu aku nulis ukara-ukara iki, tumuju jagadmu, ing wektu kowe njagong kanggo macané.
